# Code of conduct

AiOPDF welcomes people with different skills, backgrounds and languages. Help make the project useful and approachable.

- Treat contributors and users respectfully. Critique the work, not the person.
- Give clear, constructive feedback and credit other people's contributions.
- Respect privacy. Do not publish someone else's documents, personal information or credentials.
- Do not harass, threaten, discriminate, spam or make sexual advances in project spaces.
- Follow the maintainer's requests to stop disruptive behavior.

These expectations apply to issues, pull requests, discussions and other project-managed spaces. Maintainers may edit or remove harmful content, close disruptive threads or restrict participation.

Report conduct concerns to [TastingRogue](https://github.com/TastingRogue) through an available private contact channel. If no private channel is available, request one without publishing sensitive details. Security vulnerabilities follow the separate [security policy](SECURITY.md).
